name: Juan Sebastián Sánchez Urbano
headline: Data Analyst · Python, SQL and Power BI · Industrial Automation Engineer
summary: Data analyst with an industrial automation engineering background. I turn plant, sales and operations data into indicators and dashboards that support production and commercial decisions. I work with SQL, Python, R and Power BI, and design medallion-architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) ETL pipelines.

experience.role: Technical, Sales and Data Automation Advisor
experience.text: I analyze and validate customers' technical and operational information to structure comprehensive solutions, ensuring the quality and traceability of commercial records.
experience.achievement: Achievement: Designed an n8n pipeline that automatically extracts, validates and routes customer reports and information to the responsible teams, with a web chatbot.

experience.role: CNC and Robotics Area Lead (Production Data Analysis)
experience.company: Metálicas Mundial · Candelaria, Valle del Cauca
experience.text: I led the capture and analysis of critical production and quality-control variables, ensuring the reliability of manufacturing process data.
experience.achievement: I identified bottlenecks and optimized cycle times by analyzing machinery operating data under agile continuous-improvement methodologies, increasing the area's productivity.

projects.title: Predictive maintenance with Machine Learning
projects.text: Fault-severity classification model built from machine signals, with cross-validation.
projects.impact: Cross-validation accuracy of 74% on 720 simulated signals, performing best on high-severity faults.

projects.title: Production dashboard: OEE and Pareto
projects.text: OEE dashboard (availability, performance and quality) and Pareto analysis of stoppages to prioritize improvements on the production line.
projects.impact: Example with simulated data: reference OEE of 70.8%, with 92.3% availability and 94.0% quality.

projects.title: Immersive environments for phobia identification
projects.text: I designed and programmed immersive environments in Unity for Meta Quest 2, focused on identifying phobias such as fear of fire and heights.
projects.impact: I proposed a virtual-reality system that analyzes user reactions to controlled stimuli, for fear assessment and mental-health applications.

projects.title: Mobile robot control through virtual reality
projects.text: Development of a mobile-robot control system through virtual reality, using Unity and Meta Quest 2, in the Automatic Control Area of CINVESTAV.
projects.impact: Integration of serial communication, IMU and LIDAR sensors, 3D modeling and robot control from the virtual-reality environment.

projects.title: End-to-end automated ETL pipeline
projects.text: An extraction, transformation and loading architecture with Python, n8n and REST API calls to consolidate centralized databases.
projects.impact: 100% of manual data entry eliminated, with complete, standardized and reliable data for executive analysis.

projects.title: SIVIGILA epidemiological ETL 2018–2022
projects.text: An ETL process over five National Institute of Health Excel files, with extraction, transformation and loading scripts, medallion architecture and an HTML dashboard to visualize results.

projects.title: Kaismart Solutions ETL lab
projects.text: Integration of a MySQL sales table (5,000 records) with 50,000 logistics events in Excel, joined by order ID. Includes exploratory analysis, medallion architecture, 10 business questions and scheduled execution.

projects.title: Web portfolio with medallion architecture
projects.text: Site published on GitHub Pages with a repository in Bronze/Silver/Gold layers, an automated Python build and continuous deployment with GitHub Actions. Includes my own tools: an HTML reader with safe preview, a WhatsApp link generator and a JSON formatter.

projects.title: Real-time data capture and alerts (industrial IoT)
projects.text: Integration of industrial sensors and instrumentation for real-time data ingestion, automatic validation of critical operating variables and timely control alerts.

projects.title: 3D Workshop and automation services
projects.text: Custom products (printed keychains and cases, 3D printing) and automation services with n8n, AI content and industrial engineering, with a product designer connected to WhatsApp.
